title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENER - LeakageBehaviourElement
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ener/LeakageBehaviourElement. An element detailing the leakage behaviour of a storage. Subclass of Thing (http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#Thing, not itself translated in this candidate).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'LeakageBehaviourElement'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

hasFillLevelRange.description: Relationship. The range of the fill level for which this FRBC.OperationModeElement applies. If this concept is applied on a Storage it indicated the range in which a storage should remain. Relationship to NumberRange.

unitCode.description: Unit of measure code (UN/CEFACT common code where applicable).

leakageRate.description: Property. Indicates how fast the momentary fill level will decrease per second due to leakage within the given range of the fill level. Models saref:PropertyValue (core SAREF, not itself translated in this candidate): a value with its unit of measure.
